title: Bring Up
situation: Raising a machine problem in a shift meeting.
objective: Use bring up to talk about raising a problem or topic for discussion.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: During the shift meeting, I bring up a problem with the sensor.
dialogue.indonesian: Saat rapat shift, saya mengangkat masalah pada sensor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I bring up the issue because it happens again and again.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya mengangkat masalah itu karena terjadi berulang kali.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My supervisor listens and asks me to explain more.
dialogue.indonesian: Supervisor saya mendengarkan dan meminta saya menjelaskan lebih lanjut.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: It is important to bring up a problem early.
dialogue.indonesian: Penting untuk mengangkat masalah lebih awal.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After the meeting, we write the problem in the report.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah rapat, kami menulis masalah itu di laporan.

learningNotes: bring up berarti mengangkat topik atau masalah untuk dibicarakan.
bring up a problem berarti mengangkat masalah; bring up a topic berarti membahas topik.
Pronoun diletakkan di tengah: bring it up.
